items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: found out in this particular band was one of our former drummers, Godley Cartier

ctx.x: Disbanded. A musician friend of ours who formerly played with the Alphonso Trent band was living in Cleveland and he had a band working at Mammy Louise's Creole Garden, in Cleveland, Ohio. We had contacted him and he kept the job open for our reed section. Which was my partner Jeter and my brother Charles Pillars and myself.
